reviews.title: 🚨 NOTHING IS FREE? NOT EVEN A SINGLE AUDIOBOOK?!
reviews.text:
Brother, seriously?! You have to PAY for EVERY SINGLE THING you want to listen to on this app? Even the Quran?!
Some students here heard about your app, appreciated your initiative, and decided to install it. But what did they get in return? NOT A SINGLE FREE AUDIOBOOK! Just a long list of content they have to PAY to access! 💸
Even Spotify offers a FREE version! Yet your app doesn't offer even a basic free listening option?
This is the Quran we're talking about! At least make some content freely accessible to students and people who genuinely cannot afford a subscription.
You encouraged us to install your app, but only AFTER installing it did we discover that practically everything is locked behind a paywall. That's not the experience we were expecting, and it feels incredibly misleading!
⚠️ MY MESSAGE TO THE DEVELOPERS: If you're promoting an app to students and the general public, be transparent about its pricing BEFORE asking people to install it. At least offer a few free audiobooks so users can experience what you're offering.
MY VERDICT: NOT WORTH INSTALLING! ❌
If you cannot afford the subscription, this app offers you practically NOTHING. Don't waste people's time and trust just to increase your installation numbers.
An app built around the Quran should make its content accessible, not make people feel excluded because they cannot afford to pay!
